native_bound: raw graph finite sorted [0,1] endpoints zero; no explicit amplitude clamp; modified normalized targets and native feasibility enforce legality
C2_adaptive_rule: 12 joint pairs: O top 3 by valid motion then J_F, R top 4 by same rule; combine independently, no holdout influence
C4_rule: after all broad stages: choose best motion-accepted candidate in each of 3 distinct stage/phase regions; if unavailable choose task-valid by least max burden then J_F; 8 factors [.6,.8,.9,1.1,1.2,1.4,-.5,-1] per region; amplitudes clipped to preregistered +/- .2, no hidden evaluations
selection_rule: eligible = task/native ownership PASS, nonzero residual in all targeted phases, motion acceptance PASS, J_F gain >=0.5%; freeze max3 representatives: minimum J_F, minimum max raw burden among eligible, most distinct parameter region among eligible; deduplicate; no reselect after validation
validation_scope: two independent parent processes and legal prefix conditions not used for this search; existing Human and previously exposed prefix family, no population generalization; fork after common prefix at next lawful OUTBOUND request
validation_rule: B and Frozen M2 and frozen representatives on both conditions; each representative requires both gain>=0.5% and motion/native PASS; if no discovery eligible skip formal validation
storage: all compact metrics and parameter rows; compressed native traces retained under 12GiB cap for training-label value; no historical deletions
truth_firewall: fixed parameters and measured discovery outcomes only for bounded offline search; candidate context causal planner observation; simulator truth evaluation only
